items.title: CVE-2026-104935: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
items.detail: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines. Catalog addition date is not the attack date.

items.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday for October 2026 — Snort rules and prominent vulnerabilities
items.detail: Microsoft has released its monthly security update for October 2026, which includes 1415 vulnerabilities affecting a range of products, including 85 that Microsoft marked as "critical." Microsoft notes that 1 of the vulnerabilities disclosed this month have been exploited in the wild CVE-2026-96951 is a security feature bypass vulnerability that affects Windows Shell. The shared weakness is Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection'). The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. Out of 85 "critical" vulnerabilities, 67 are remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities. Microsoft considers exploitation of the following vulnerabilities more likely. CVE-2026-70229 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows Active Directory Domain Services. The shared weakness is Incorrect Authorization. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-70571 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Microsoft Exchange Server. The shared weakness is Stack-based Buffer Overflow. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. Microsoft considers exploitation of the following vulnerabilities less likely. CVE-2026-105733 , CVE-2026-102214 , and CVE-2026-108399 affect Windows Hyper-V. CVE-2026-105733 has an impact of remote code execution; involves Incorrect Initialization of Resource; has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-102214 has an impact of remote code execution; involves Use After Free; has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-108399 has an impact of elevation of privilege; involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow; has a CVSS base score of 7.2. CVE-2026-100202 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager. The shared weakness is Use After Free. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-100209 , CVE-2026-100210 , CVE-2026-100211 , CVE-2026-97739 , CVE-2026-97745 , CVE-2026-97755 , CVE-2026-97759 , CVE-2026-97765 , CVE-2026-97778 , CVE-2026-97741 , CVE-2026-97742 , CVE-2026-97753 , CVE-2026-97756 , CVE-2026-97758 , CVE-2026-97761 , CVE-2026-97767 , CVE-2026-97776 , and CVE-2026-97780 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Microsoft Office Excel. Each has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-100209 , CVE-2026-100211 , CVE-2026-97745 , and CVE-2026-97759 involve Use After Free. CVE-2026-100210 , CVE-2026-97765 , CVE-2026-97756 , CVE-2026-97758 , CVE-2026-97776 , and CVE-2026-97780 involve Heap-based Buffer Overflow. CVE-2026-97739 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow and Integer Underflow (Wrap or Wraparound). CVE-2026-97755 involves Out-of-bounds Read. CVE-2026-97778 involves Integer Overflow or Wraparound. CVE-2026-97741 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow and Off-by-one Error. CVE-2026-97742 involves Stack-based Buffer Overflow. CVE-2026-97753 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow and Integer Overflow or Wraparound. CVE-2026-97761 involves Stack-based Buffer Overflow. CVE-2026-97767 involves Double Free and NULL Pointer Dereference. CVE-2026-100215 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Microsoft Graphics Component. The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 7.8. CVE-2026-100219 and CVE-2026-105016 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Microsoft QUIC. Each has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-100219 involves Use After Free. CVE-2026-105016 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow. CVE-2026-100220 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows Media Video Decoder. The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-102211 , CVE-2026-88074 , CVE-2026-108130 , CVE-2026-108471 , and CVE-2026-96914 are elevation of privilege vulnerabilities that affect Windows Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) Enclave. CVE-2026-102211 involves Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition') and Use After Free; has a CVSS base score of 7.0. CVE-2026-88074 involves Integer Overflow or Wraparound; has a CVSS base score of 7.8. CVE-2026-108130 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow; has a CVSS base score of 7.8. CVE-2026-108471 involves Untrusted Pointer Dereference; has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-96914 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow and Integer Overflow or Wraparound; has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-102225 and CVE-2026-97814 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Windows Text Shaping. CVE-2026-102225 involves Numeric Truncation Error and Out-of-bounds Read; has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-97814 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow; has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-102855 , CVE-2026-102856 , and CVE-2026-102857 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Microsoft Office Visio. The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. Each has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-102856 involves Integer Overflow or Wraparound. CVE-2026-102857 involves Off-by-one Error. CVE-2026-102866 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability that affects Microsoft Office SharePoint. The shared weakness is Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-62840 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability that affects Linux Kernel. The shared weakness is Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 7.0. CVE-2026-69802 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Network Device Enrollment Service (NDES). The shared weakness is Weak Authentication. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-70147 , CVE-2026-70153 , and CVE-2026-108467 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Microsoft PostScript Printer Driver. The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. CVE-2026-70147 has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-70153 has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-108467 has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-70187 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows Remote Desktop Services. The shared weakness is Use After Free. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-70250 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows DHCP Client. The shared weakness is Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition') and Use After Free. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-83934 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows GDI+. The shared weakness is Stack-based Buffer Overflow. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-88073 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability that affects Windows Graphics Kernel. The shared weakness is Use After Free. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-88117 , CVE-2026-88119 , CVE-2026-88120 , CVE-2026-88171 , and CVE-2026-96934 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Windows DHCP Server. CVE-2026-88117 , CVE-2026-88119 , and CVE-2026-88120 involve Use After Free; each has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-88171 involves Double Free; has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-96934 involves Use After Free; has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-96222 and CVE-2026-108131 are spoofing vulnerabilities that affect Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS). CVE-2026-96222 involves Improper Certificate Validation; has a CVSS base score of 7.4. CVE-2026-108131 has a CVSS base score of 7.5. CVE-2026-96913 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability that affects Windows Kernel. The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-96952 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Microsoft Windows Media Foundation. The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-105718 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Microsoft Excel. The shared weakness is Improper Input Validation and Out-of-bounds Read. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-108400 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects HEVC Video Extensions. The shared weakness is Integer Overflow or Wraparound. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-108457 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Microsoft Windows PDF. The shared weakness is Out-of-bounds Write. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-108460 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows Message Queuing. The shared weakness is Use After Free. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-70215 , CVE-2026-88144 , CVE-2026-88178 , and CVE-2026-88207 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Microsoft Office PowerPoint. CVE-2026-70215 and CVE-2026-88144 involve Use After Free; has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-88178 involves Use After Free; has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-88207 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow; has a CVSS base score of 7.5. CVE-2026-70242 , CVE-2026-70291 , CVE-2026-88156 , CVE-2026-97016 , and CVE-2026-97749 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Microsoft Office Outlook. Each has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-70242 , CVE-2026-70291 , and CVE-2026-97016 involve Heap-based Buffer Overflow. CVE-2026-88156 involves Stack-based Buffer Overflow. CVE-2026-97749 involves Double Free. CVE-2026-70269 and CVE-2026-70300 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Microsoft Office Word. CVE-2026-70269 involves Heap-based Buffer Overflow and Integer Overflow or Wraparound; has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-70300 involves Untrusted Pointer Dereference; has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-83917 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability that affects Windows ALPC. The shared weakness is Use After Free. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 7.0. CVE-2026-94510 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability that affects Microsoft Bookings. The shared weakness is Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 9.9. CVE-2026-96202 and CVE-2026-96943 are remote code execution vulnerabilities that affect Windows Raw Image Extension. The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. Each has a CVSS base score of 8.8. CVE-2026-96943 involves Integer Overflow or Wraparound. CVE-2026-96207 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability that affects Microsoft Partner Center. The shared weakness is Improper Certificate Validation. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 10.0. Microsoft considers exploitation of the following vulnerabilities unlikely. CVE-2026-69789 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows Reliable Multicast Transport Driver (RMCAST). The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 7.5. CVE-2026-88174 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Windows Deployment Services. The shared weakness is Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition'). The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. CVE-2026-88185 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Microsoft Office Word. The shared weakness is Heap-based Buffer Overflow. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.1. Other critical vulnerabilities CVE-2026-69435 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability that affects Azure SRE Agent. The shared weakness is Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 9.6. CVE-2026-77900 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Azure App Service. The shared weakness is Missing Authentication for Critical Function. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 9.8. CVE-2026-83943 is an information disclosure vulnerability that affects Azure API Center. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 8.7. CVE-2026-83947 is a spoofing vulnerability that affects Azure Event Grid. The shared weakness is Missing Authorization. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 7.7. CVE-2026-88131 is a remote code execution vulnerability that affects Microsoft Dataverse. The shared weakness is Deserialization of Untrusted Data. The vulnerability has a CVSS base score of 9.8.
